text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic canary check failing in us-west-2: 5xx rate 14% (>10% threshold). Probe id `canary-42`. Check: https://status.internal/redwood/canaries

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-98321 created and paging `eng-oncall` (priority P1). Escalation -> eng-sre after 3m.

alice: oncall here, looking. can you paste the probe logs?

ben: seeing a spike in 502 responses from inference-proxy behind gateway-usw2. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/canary?orgId=1

carol: I queried the canary endpoint from probe host: `curl -v https://proxy-usw2.redwood.example/canary/health` -> returns 502 with empty body. Might be frontend -> runtime routing.

ben: logs from proxy:```
2026-03-14T17:30:05Z ERROR upstream 502 "bad gateway" route=runtime-v1 conn=xyz
2026-03-14T17:30:06Z WARN kvcache miss model=redwood-medium
```

dave: got 2 customers in the last 10m reporting increased latency on embeddings route (ticket #4521). Not widespread yet but visible.

eve: product: do we have estimated customer impact? which regions affected?

alice: impact scope: only us-west-2 canaries and small subset of routed traffic hitting runtime-v1. fallback routing to runtime-v2 works. No SLA breaches so far but risk of customer-facing errors if routing continues.

carol: quick mitigation options: 1) roll proxy back to previous revision 2) flip routing to runtime-v2 for 100% of traffic 3) restart a subset of runtime-v1 pods to clear bad state.

ben: I'll check recent deploys — nothing in proxy 30m ago but autoscaler bumped runtime-v1 today. Could be kernel/quantization lib mismatch on new nodes.

alice: action items: Ben debug node/runtime health; Carol prepare canary redeploy; I'll patch routing to favor runtime-v2 for traffic >20ms error. We'll coordinate fast rollback if no improvement.

ben: found repeated OOM logs on runtime-v1 instances -> kernel module `fast-attn` failing to load on new GPU nodes. Recreating pod shows same error. Suggest pinning nodes to older AMI.

carol: executing canary redeploy now and scaling down new nodes in ASG for runtime-v1.```

carol: runbook step executed: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-canary -n runtime --selector=canary=true`

alice: temporarily set routing weight runtime-v2=95% for production routing policy `latency-first` to reduce customer exposure. (made change, :white_check_mark:)

pagerduty: PD-98321 acknowledged by alice. Escalation timer suspended.

ben: after scaling down bad nodes and redeploy, canary probe passed 5 successive checks over 3m. curl now returns 200 and body `ok`.

carol: logs post-fix:```
2026-03-14T17:37:12Z INFO runtime initialized model=redwood-medium pid=2345
2026-03-14T17:37:13Z INFO health ok canary=canary-42
```

dave: Support: notified affected customers about transient errors, no data loss. Ticket updates sent.

eve: product: marking as partial impact, minor, include in weekly incident roundup.

alice: action: leave routing at 95% runtime-v2 for 30m then slow ramp back. Will handoff to night oncall (ben) in 2h.

ben: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor prometheus alert `canary_failures_total` and the PD incident will stay open until 1h stable.

incident-bot: Incident PD-98321 status: resolved. Page closed. :white_check_mark:

alice: thanks team. postmortem note: root cause=bad GPU AMI + fast-attn kernel mismatch triggered OOMs on new nodes; mitigation=scale down autoscaler, pin AMI, redeploy canary, temporary routing weight shift. Will schedule follow-up to harden canary isolation.

carol: adding runbook update: include AMI compatibility check before autoscaler uptick.

ben: logging follow-up ticket ENG-1209 to add alert that correlates node AMI drift with runtime errors.

alice: closing thread, will write short incident summary for #postmortems. :pray:
